get.summary: List auth configs.

post.summary: Create an auth config.

delete.summary: Delete an auth config. One with connected accounts is refused unless an admin in the browser passes force, which revokes and removes the accounts.

get.summary: Read an auth config. Secret values are never returned.

post.summary: Disable an auth config: new connections are refused, existing accounts keep working.
Enable an auth config.

put.summary: Replace secret fields. Values are write-only.

post.summary: Set new secret values and keep the previous ones for a grace period.
Create a link an end user opens to connect an account. The address is shown once and works until it expires.

get.summary: Read a link’s status: initiated, completed, failed or expired.
List connected accounts.

post.summary: Bring in a connection the product already holds: an API key, basic login or bearer token, or the refresh token of its own OAuth app. The account is active at once.
Import up to 1,000 connections as a job. Read each row’s outcome from the job.

delete.summary: Disconnect an account: the grant is revoked at the provider where the connector allows it, then the stored credential is deleted.

get.summary: Read a connected account. Credentials are never returned.

patch.summary: Rename an account or make it the primary one for its owner and service.
Push new credential values for an account made from credentials the product holds. Named fields are replaced, a null removes one, omitted fields stay.

get.summary: List the project’s end users, optionally those whose id starts with a search text.

post.summary: Create an end user by the product’s own id for them. Creating the same id again returns the existing end user.

delete.summary: Erase an end user: grants revoked, credentials, sessions, memory, files and passkeys deleted. Runs as a job; the answer is 202.

get.summary: Read an end user by the product’s id for them.

patch.summary: Set or remove the email used to verify the person before they enroll a passkey.

get.summary: Read a job: its status and counts and, for a batch import, the outcome of every row. A project key sees the jobs the product started; a member sees their own, an administrator the organization's.

post.summary: Return an installation to an earlier version.

get.summary: Read the update an installed listing has available and the installation’s update settings.

put.summary: Choose how an installation follows new versions.

get.summary: Search the workflow marketplace.
Read one listing with its published versions.
Estimate what running a listing’s workflow costs.

post.summary: Announce the date a listing stops being offered.
Start installing a listing; answers with the address that finishes the install.
Report a listing to its publisher and the platform.

get.summary: Read the reviews of a listing.

patch.summary: Edit the organization’s own review of a listing.

post.summary: Review a listing once the organization has run its workflow.
Mark a published version deprecated with an optional note.
Withdraw a published version for a stated reason; installs stop receiving it.

get.summary: Read the organization’s publisher profile with the proofs it has given.

post.summary: Create the organization’s publisher profile.

get.summary: List the publisher’s listings with their standing.
List the reports made about the publisher’s listings.

put.summary: Register the public key the publisher signs versions with.

post.summary: Start proving control of a domain; answers with where to publish the proof.
Check whether the domain proof is published.
Send a confirmation message to the publisher’s support address.
Confirm the support address with the token that was sent to it.
Answer a report made about the publisher’s listing.
Reply once to a review of the publisher’s listing.
Submit a workflow version to the marketplace for review.

get.summary: List the publisher handles that are off limits.

post.summary: Put a publisher handle off limits.

delete.summary: Lift the flag on a publisher handle.

post.summary: Withdraw any publisher’s published version for a stated reason.

get.summary: List every publisher with its tier, standing and listing count.

patch.summary: Move a publisher between the community and verified tiers.

post.summary: Hide a publisher’s listings for a stated reason.
Hide a review with a reason its author can read.

get.summary: List the submissions waiting for a platform administrator, elevated ones first.

post.summary: Approve a submission or ask for changes.

get.summary: List the organization’s projects.

post.summary: Create a project.

delete.summary: Delete a project and revoke its keys.

get.summary: Read a project. A server key may read its own project only.

patch.summary: Change a project’s settings, or suspend and resume it.

post.summary: Make a new secret for verifying the signed parameters a connect link adds to the callback address. It is shown once; the old one stops working at once.

get.summary: List a project’s keys. Secrets are never returned.

post.summary: Create a server key. The token is shown once.

get.summary: The fields and scopes needed to create an auth config for a service.
List the organization's jobs, newest first. A member sees the jobs they started; an administrator sees all of them. No job input is returned.

post.summary: Stop a job and the branches it started. A job that already finished is returned unchanged.
Start a failed or dead job again with the same input. Administrators only.

browserSession.description: A signed-in member session or member key.
